scripts.start:api: cd services/api && npm install && node server.js
scripts.install:all: cd services/api && npm install && cd ../ui && npm install
scripts.version: node -e "const v = require('./package.json').version; ['services/api/package.json', 'services/ui/package.json'].forEach(f => { const p = require('./' + f); p.version = v; require('fs').writeFileSync(f, JSON.stringify(p, null, 2) + '\n'); });" && git add services/api/package*.json services/ui/package*.json
